title: Are game jams a good way to test AI tools?
author: Little_Total3520
selftext:
For context, I'm very much a beginner in game development, I've opened Unity maybe 10 times in my life. I came across this game jam that said it was suitable for beginners and they're letting people use their AI tool for free. 

I'm wondering if this is something I should try, or would it just be a waste of time? Since I'm not super familiar with AI tools, seems like a good way to test them and see what I can make. 

I've also never participated in a jam before, but I guess there are no downside? :D 

Thanks for any tips!

comments.author: United-Bell-382
comments.body:
You need to start somewhere. Try it dude. Worst case you can't make a game to submit in time. But gaining experience is almost guaranteed and it's what you need right now.

If you have the time I would say go for it.

replies.author: Little_Total3520
replies.body: thanks! i guess even if i wont be able to submit, the pressure will make do something at least lol
